basic_info.description: Fantastic opportunity to own a classic Craftsman-style condo in coveted Mission Dolores! This spacious 3-bedroom, 1-bath flat seamlessly blends period charm with endless potential. Stunning architectural details include elegant box beam ceilings, stained glass transoms, coved ceilings, and rich ebony-finished floors. The generously sized primary bedroom connects to a bright sunroom/office with direct garden access, perfect for remote work or relaxation. The expansive second bedroom offers a peaceful retreat overlooking a serene garden, while the flexible third bedroom can serve as a media room, guest space, or creative flex area. The eat-in kitchen includes a pantry and laundry area for added convenience. While this home retains its historic character, it's ready for your vision to truly shine. Includes 1-car independent parking and extra storage. Steps from Whole Foods and the Valencia Corridor where you can find vibrant dining, shopping, parks, and easy transit, this is a rare chance to create your dream home in a prime San Francisco location!
